question: Should OpenClaw adopt this RFC as the experimental contract for portable Claw packages and proceed with the linked staged OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation stack?
rationale: The remaining question is whether this new lifecycle and compatibility surface belongs in the product; it cannot be resolved safely by a mechanical documentation edit or automated repair.

options.title: Keep incubating the RFC
options.body: Leave the RFC open while maintainers validate the desired core scope and compatibility commitments against the linked experimental implementation stack.

options.title: Sponsor staged adoption
options.body: Accept the RFC as the experimental product contract and review the linked implementation PRs as the controlled landing path.

options.title: Decline the core contract
options.body: Close the proposal only if maintainers decide portable whole-agent packages should not become an OpenClaw core capability.

recommendation.title: Keep incubating the RFC
recommendation.body: Leave the RFC open while maintainers validate the desired core scope and compatibility commitments against the linked experimental implementation stack.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible review discussion directly covers the unresolved terminology and MCP ownership boundaries that feed the product-contract decision.
